descriptionFull: Clark's nutcracker ( Nucifraga columbiana ), sometimes referred to as Clark's crow or woodpecker crow , is a passerine bird in the family Corvidae. It is slightly smaller than its Eurasian relative the spotted nutcracker ( N. caryocatactes ). It is ashy-grey all over except for the black-and-white wings and central tail feathers (the outer ones are white). The bill, legs and feet are also black. This bird derives its name from the explorer William Clark.
